pricingStatus.freeAccountAnswer: Yes. Free accounts support up to 10 plants and 6 household members without a credit card.
pricingStatus.paidOfferAnswer: No. Free accounts are available, but the hosted site does not currently accept purchases or offer paid plans.
pricingStatus.reactivationAnswer: No. Reactivation requires a dated status decision, reviewed source and infrastructure changes, non-production verification, and a separately approved deployment.
pricingStatus.trialAnswer: Every paid subscription begins with a 14-day trial. You are not charged until it ends, and cancelling before then costs nothing. Lifetime purchases are a one-time charge and have no trial.
pricingStatus.changeQuestion: Can I change or cancel later?
pricingStatus.changeAnswer: Yes. Plan changes and cancellation are self-service from Settings → Billing, which opens our payment provider's portal. Cancelling returns your household to the free Seedling tier at the end of the paid period.
pricingStatus.whereAnswer: Plan changes happen inside your account, under Settings → Billing, and are made by a household admin. Purchases are not offered in the mobile apps.
pricingStatus.dataAnswerHeld: Existing plants, household records, tasks, and care history remain available under the current plan limits. The hold does not delete user data.
pricingStatus.dataAnswerOpen: Nothing is deleted when a plan changes. If a downgrade puts you over the new caps, existing plants and members stay readable and editable — only adding more is blocked until you are back under the limit.
pricingStatus.householdQuestion: Does everyone in my household need their own plan?
pricingStatus.householdAnswer: No. One plan covers the whole household. A household admin holds the subscription, and every member shares the same plants, tasks, and care history under it — up to the member limit shown on each plan.
pricingStatus.cardQuestion: Do I need a credit card?
pricingStatus.cardAnswer: Not for a free account — the Seedling tier needs no card at all. Starting a paid plan goes through our payment provider's checkout, which collects a card before the trial begins; nothing is charged until the 14-day trial ends.

pricing.trialNote: Monthly and yearly plans begin with a 14-day trial. Checkout collects a card up front, you are not charged until the 14 days are up, and cancelling before then costs nothing. A lifetime plan is a single payment and has no trial.
